title: Hearing Armstrong in Papa Celestin's band
summary: Thomas never heard Oliver but heard Armstrong in Papa Celestin's brass band at the fairgrounds, where Celestin started the band with a two-by-four.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Do you remember Joe Oliver? Did you ever hear him before he went north? No. No I don't. Or Armstrong did you hear him when you were a kid? You'd be pretty young.
Well I heard Armstrong yes. Armstrong was playing in Papa Sutterstein's band for a while. Oh that's right.

Yeah and I went to dance at the fairground and I can't forget that Papa Sutterstein used to use a big two by four to start the band off. Oh really? It was a big band you know. Big brass band and so he hit on the side of the bandstand bam bam bam. And the band you know started playing so many licks the band would start. I said it used to tickle me. Make sure they all heard when the signal was stopped you know. I mean Papa used to tickle me with that. Lewis Armstrong was right side of Papa blowing that trumpet. And so well I've heard Lewis Armstrong with six, seven pieces too you know. Yeah. For a little while not too long not too much. Because he went away when he got to getting real pretty good. He went away and so the only thing I heard was his records. And I mean he made some records too. Yeah. I really enjoyed it.
